contract.selection: All prior evolution datasets with at least five original blocks; first ten blocks or complete shorter file. No selection by new gains.
contract.initial: Reuse exact original block-0 extraction and fixed storage from R57/R61/R63/R65; no new baseline synthesis.
contract.trigger: At end of block 2: blocks 1 AND 2 each have >=10 local eligible residual groups, OR each has archive/raw >=1.10 times block0. Group >=50 lines and >=2 values. No future information.
contract.candidate: One fresh whole-plan LLM resynthesis from block2 using existing generic sampler. Whole-plan replacement permits same-tag refinements, removal and new rules. Old plan remains fallback. GPT-4o, temperature0, max20 calls, max_tokens16384, no HTTP retries.
contract.fit: Candidate storage fitted only on block2. Matched old-program storage-only refit on block2 isolates benefit beyond changing storage policy.
contract.validation: Original block3, not used for synthesis, sampling, trigger or fitting. Candidate must save >=1% complete archive bytes against BOTH original frozen plan/storage and old-program refit. Must pass exact reconstruction and median of three interleaved encodes <=1.20x original frozen time.
contract.publication: After block3 only. Immutable plan+policy through all future blocks4..9; no adaptation to future gains. Candidate verified on block2 before block3. No per-dataset thresholds.
contract.future: Report every dataset, triggers, candidates, errors, rejects, publications and all future gains/zeros/regressions. Old-program refit is a separately measured control, never auto-published. Runtime candidate failure recorded and fallback frozen archive produced; unsuccessful attempt cost included.
contract.scope: Developmental follow-up, one attempt/dataset, shared host descriptive timing; cannot estimate general high-probability success or statistical superiority.
contract.units: Ratios raw bytes/complete archive bytes. Synthesis and fit/gate costs separated from online encode time. No conversion of seconds to bytes.

historical_state_scope: Each compression/decode benchmark invocation used a new CLI process. The block-1/block-2 observer reused runtime imports in a dataset process without the later R71 data-cache reset. No retrospective R71 cold-guard guarantee is claimed.
